title.narrative: Contribute towards achieving the targets of National Strategic Plan aligned with End TB Strategy for reducing the burden of TB and MDR-TB in Pakistan. - Pakistan (01-Jul-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Pakistan, Tuberculosis, National TB Control Programme Pakistan (NTP)This program has the following goals: To reduce TB mortality rate by 40% by 2023 compared to 2015. To reduce estimated TB incidence by at least 4% in 2023 compared to 2015. The objectives of this program are: To detect and notify at least 1,300,000 cases of new TB episode during the years 2021 to 2023. To maintain the annual treatment success rate at 90% and over during the years 2021 to 2023. To enroll in treatment with 2nd line TB medicines 21,000 cases of MDR/RR-TB cases during the years 2021 to 2023. To ensure the provision of preventive TB therapy to at least 650,000 eligible people during the years 2021 to 2023. To Implement case based DHIS-2 in 1,611 TB health care facilities by the end of June 2024. To Implement case based DHIS-2 in 1,611 TB health care facilities by the end of June 2024. To provide improved WASH services in the targeted 1425 Healthcare facilities and TB clinic to reduce the vulnerability of infectious diseases by 2025. To provide improved WASH services in the targeted 1425 Healthcare facilities and TB clinic to reduce the vulnerability of infectious diseases by 2025. To enhance the capacity of 2130 Community Healthcare Workers and sanitary staff on infection prevention and control to respond the COVID19 and break the chain of infection, by 2025.. To enhance the capabilities of 12 Community-based organizations to respond to infectious diseases outbreaks and advocate for social accountability. title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for PAK-T-NTPP04
Percentage of health facilities providing diagnostic services with tracer items available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Percentage of health facilities with tracer medicines for the three diseases available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - private/non-governmental facilities
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - public sector
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB started on treatment for MDR-TB who were lost to follow up during the first six months of treatment
TCP Other- 3: Proportion of bacteriologically positive TB cases among new and relapse pulmonary TB cases.
TCP Other-2: Proportion of contacts of people with bacteriologically confirmed TB who were screened for active TB
Percentage of PLHIV on ART who initiated TB preventive therapy among those eligible during the reporting period
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid tests at the time of diagnosis
TCP Other -1: Number of samples tested on Xpert through specimen transportation
Percentage of confirmed RR/MDR-TB cases tested for resistance to second-line drugs
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - community referrals

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
Timeliness of facility reporting: Percentage of submitted facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Outcome indicators targets and results for PAK-T-NTPP04
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Impact indicators targets and results for PAK-T-NTPP04
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
